title: A trumpeter, and the drummer Alas Snyder who could read
summary: They recall a trumpet player who played in a big band and a powerful drummer, Snyder, who could read well.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: This trumpet player went away long. He used to play with… Long time ago, man. What's that boy?
You know where he lived out there?
Yeah, he used to play with a big band, I can't call them people's names, Lucky Miller or something. Was Lucky Miller that one? No, no, right before them.
That was a good boy, he taught him. Yeah, he was great. He was a good drummer player, man. One of them big power boomers.

Yeah, Alas Snyder, yeah. Now that's a song that I used to like to hear play a band of all of them. Boy, that's a good boy, Alas Snyder. Now that's a song that I used to like to hear play a band of all.
Boy, he could read too, boy. That guy could read.

Boy. See, he'd get on the corner when they were on them avatizing. Well, he couldn't do nothing with Kirin and them on them avatizing. But he'd play that band of all from the top. Da da da da da da da. You know, all the way from the beginning. You know, just the chorus. Da da da da da da. I know everything. All right.
